Audiveris 5.11.0 is used separately by a local, unmodified source-built executable.
It is not included in this hosted site's archive. License: AGPL-3.0.
Source: https://github.com/Audiveris/audiveris/tree/5.11.0

The original sheet-music PDF was supplied by the owner for private practice.
The full-score recognition is an OMR draft, requiring comparison with that PDF.
The opening pickup is numbered 0; the final printed measure is 51.
Measures 36–40 were separately checked and corrected against the PDF.
